notes: «ومولى، لهم» is a freedman with no name: an unnamed link beside Alqama, joined at one level as co-transmitters («أنهما حدثاه»)
«عن أبيه، وائل بن حجر»: the father is written with his name, so the link is the name alone («وائل بن حجر»)
«وصف همام حيال أذنيه» is an editor's description of a gesture: left out
